commands.command: git fetch --prune origin && test "$(git rev-parse origin/main)" = "771b23456cf7b3fafe62cba3263e1f8f7118580b"

ADB="$HOME/Library/Android/sdk/platform-tools/adb"; SERIAL=$("$ADB" devices | awk 'NR>1 && $2=="device" {print $1; exit}'); test -n "$SERIAL"; "$ADB" -s "$SERIAL" shell am start -n link.localclimate.app/.MainActivity >/dev/null; sleep 1; PID=$("$ADB" -s "$SERIAL" shell pidof link.localclimate.app | tr -d '\r'); test -n "$PID"; "$ADB" -s "$SERIAL" forward --remove tcp:9222 >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; "$ADB" -s "$SERIAL" forward tcp:9222 localabstract:webview_devtools_remote_$PID >/dev/null; sleep 1; curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:9222/json >/dev/null

WS=$(curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:9222/json | python3 -c 'import json,sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin)[0]["webSocketDebuggerUrl"])'); WS="$WS" node -e 'const ws=new WebSocket(process.env.WS);ws.onopen=()=>ws.send(JSON.stringify({id:1,method:"Runtime.evaluate",params:{expression:`(()=>{const b=[...document.querySelectorAll("button")].find(x=>x.innerText.includes("Control temperature"));if(!b)throw new Error("temp missing");b.click();return true})()`,returnByValue:true}}));ws.onmessage=e=>{const m=JSON.parse(e.data);if(m.id===1){if(m.result.exceptionDetails)process.exit(1);ws.close();}}' && sleep 1

WS=$(curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:9222/json | python3 -c 'import json,sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin)[0]["webSocketDebuggerUrl"])'); WS="$WS" node -e 'const ws=new WebSocket(process.env.WS);ws.onopen=()=>ws.send(JSON.stringify({id:1,method:"Runtime.evaluate",params:{expression:`(()=>{const b=[...document.querySelectorAll("button")].find(x=>x.innerText.trim()==="Add plug");if(!b)throw new Error("Add plug missing");b.click();return true})()`,returnByValue:true}}));ws.onmessage=e=>{const m=JSON.parse(e.data);if(m.id===1){if(m.result.exceptionDetails)process.exit(1);ws.close();}}' && sleep 1

WS=$(curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:9222/json | python3 -c 'import json,sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin)[0]["webSocketDebuggerUrl"])'); WS="$WS" node -e 'const ws=new WebSocket(process.env.WS);ws.onopen=()=>ws.send(JSON.stringify({id:1,method:"Runtime.evaluate",params:{expression:`(()=>{const e=document.querySelector("input");if(!e)throw new Error("input missing");e.focus();return document.body.innerText.includes("Scan network")})()`,returnByValue:true}}));ws.onmessage=e=>{const m=JSON.parse(e.data);if(m.id===1){console.log("MODAL_BEFORE_BACK="+m.result.result.value);ws.close();}}' && sleep 1

ADB="$HOME/Library/Android/sdk/platform-tools/adb"; SERIAL=$("$ADB" devices | awk 'NR>1 && $2=="device" {print $1; exit}'); "$ADB" -s "$SERIAL" shell input keyevent 4; sleep 1; printf '%s\n' '--- after Back 1 ---'; "$ADB" -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys input_method | grep -E 'mInputShown|mIsInputViewShown' | head -10 || true; curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:9222/json || true

commands.command: if curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:9222/json | python3 -c 'import json,sys; raise SystemExit(0 if json.load(sys.stdin) else 1)'; then WS=$(curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:9222/json | python3 -c 'import json,sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin)[0]["webSocketDebuggerUrl"])'); WS="$WS" node -e 'const ws=new WebSocket(process.env.WS);ws.onopen=()=>ws.send(JSON.stringify({id:1,method:"Runtime.evaluate",params:{expression:`JSON.stringify({modal:document.body.innerText.includes("Scan network"),temp:document.body.innerText.includes("Temperature control"),root:document.body.innerText.includes("What do you want to do?")})`,returnByValue:true}}));ws.onmessage=e=>{const m=JSON.parse(e.data);if(m.id===1){console.log("STATE_AFTER_BACK1="+m.result.result.value);ws.close();}}'; fi

ADB="$HOME/Library/Android/sdk/platform-tools/adb"; SERIAL=$("$ADB" devices | awk 'NR>1 && $2=="device" {print $1; exit}'); "$ADB" -s "$SERIAL" shell input keyevent 4; sleep 1; printf '%s\n' '--- after Back 2 ---'; printf 'PID='; "$ADB" -s "$SERIAL" shell pidof link.localclimate.app || true; curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:9222/json || true

ADB="$HOME/Library/Android/sdk/platform-tools/adb"; SERIAL=$("$ADB" devices | awk 'NR>1 && $2=="device" {print $1; exit}'); "$ADB" -s "$SERIAL" forward --remove tcp:9222 >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; git status --short; git diff --check
